en.headline: Observatory forecasts fine and dry weather for Chung Yeung weekend
en.dek: Rain patches are expected on Saturday and Sunday morning before conditions turn mainly fine and dry from later on the Chung Yeung Festival through early next week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a fresh easterly airstream is affecting the coast of Guangdong, bringing mainly cloudy skies with one or two rain patches in the morning and at night on Saturday. Temperatures are expected to range between 27 and 30 degrees, with moderate to fresh easterly winds.

On Sunday, the Chung Yeung Festival, the Observatory expects mainly cloudy conditions with one or two light rain patches in the morning, becoming fine and dry later in the day. The fine and dry weather is forecast to continue into early next week, with hot conditions during the day by midweek.

Monday is a public holiday following the festival. The Observatory has not issued any tropical cyclone signals or rainstorm warnings for the territory, though strong winds are affecting adjacent coastal waters. Residents planning hill visits are advised to monitor conditions.

zh.headline: 天文台預測重陽節周末轉晴乾燥
zh.dek: 周六及周日早上有一兩陣雨，重陽節稍後至下周初大致天晴及乾燥，中期日間炎熱。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股清勁的偏東氣流正影響廣東沿岸。周六大致多雲，早晚有一兩陣雨，日間部分時間有陽光，氣溫介乎27至30度，吹和緩至清勁東風。
周日重陽節早上大致多雲，有一兩陣微雨，稍後轉晴及乾燥。天氣將持續至下周初，下週中期日間炎熱。下周一為重陽節翌日公眾假期。
天文台目前未有發出熱帶氣旋警告信號或暴雨警告，但鄰近海域吹強風。市民如計劃登高掃墓，應留意最新天氣情況。
